startCard.title: Start new collection
startCard.subtitle: Purview eDiscovery · Reuses onboarding sign-in automatically
startCard.desc: Collect Copilot prompts/responses into Microsoft Purview eDiscovery by specifying a target user (UPN) and an optional date range. It automatically reuses the onboarding sign-in, so no additional sign-in is needed (a device code prompt appears only as a fallback). Stopped or failed jobs can be resumed from the history below.

credentials.title: Download account (ME3 auto-download)
credentials.desc: eDiscovery Standard (ME3) tenants require a browser sign-in to download exports. Registering a dedicated non-MFA service account enables automatic download with no sign-in prompt. (MFA accounts still require manual approval in the window after auto-fill.) The password is encrypted with Windows DPAPI and stored only in this profile on this PC.
